items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: when Cosmo called us and we started doing these things

ctx.x: So speaking of people, people, why do you think this clique, why do you think this group continued to get quote-unquote most of the session work? I mean, what was the, beyond their musical ability? I mean, beyond their musical ability.

I think that when Cosmo called us and we started doing these things and people were saying, hey, man, they sound good together. Now people say, man, you guys had a clique. It wasn't by, by us saying that we don't want to play with anybody else. Yeah. It was just that the people that would come in, the independents would come in and say, we want the guys that played on such and such an album. Oh,
